purpose: Define evidence-based classification, scope assessment, priority and responder assignment without treating alert severity or model output as conclusive incident truth.

topics.name: Incident Triage
topics.purpose: Define evidence-based classification, scope assessment, priority and responder assignment without treating alert severity or model output as conclusive incident truth.

semantics.evidence_rule: Assessment uses exact alert/audit/error/runtime/data evidence refs.
semantics.severity_rule: Incident severity/priority is explicit triage output.
semantics.scope_rule: Affected scope is evidence-backed and revisable.
semantics.model_rule: AI/tool triage suggestions remain candidate evidence.
semantics.authority_rule: Triage assignment does not automatically grant resource access; needed rights are separately authorized.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.

hard_gates.condition: model declares breach automatically without evidence
alert severity copied as final incident severity always

references.purpose: Triage updates exact incident case evidence.
